title: Missing nullability annotations nvm registration write_cb/read_cb
description: include/lichen/oscore.h:274-275 clang -Wnullability-completeness flagged; every other public API annotated _Nonnull/_Nullable. Two-token completeness fix.
close_reason: Added _Nullable annotations to both callback params of oscore_nvm_register_callbacks() (include/lichen/oscore.h) matching sibling style: oscore_nvm_write_cb _Nullable write_cb, oscore_nvm_read_cb _Nullable read_cb (NULL disables, per the doc comment). Also annotated the matching definition signature in oscore_ctx.c so declaration and definition stay identical. Header's existing !__clang__/!__has_feature(nullability) empty-macro fallback (oscore.h:70-77) makes the annotations inert under GCC/Zephyr builds — expanded form is textually the pre-change signature. Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -Wnullability-completeness clean on all 7 oscore TUs at default and max Kconfig configs; no PRIu64/format drift. Note: coap_oscore.c (another oscore.h consumer) could not be syntax-checked in this sandbox because it requires the full zephyr/net CoAP+net_ip headers not worth stubbing for this leaf scope; its exposure to this change is limited to the two headers, both validated tree-wide elsewhere (dead macro proven zero-ref; annotation placement identical to 20+ existing annotated declarations in the same header).
